_readme: HOW TO UPDATE DECK LINKS:
When a presentation deck is ready:
1. Upload the file (PPT or PDF) to Box
2. Right-click → Share → Copy Shared Link
3. Open admin.html, paste the link into the matching session, click Save & Publish
4. The dashboard updates live within ~30 seconds — no other changes needed
To flag a re-download (file was replaced/updated):
• In admin.html, toggle 'Re-download required' for that session → Save & Publish
• The dashboard will show a pulsing orange badge next to the Download button
• Once the AV team has re-downloaded, toggle it off → Save & Publish
To flag XLR audio feed required:
• In admin.html, toggle 'XLR Feed' for that session → Save & Publish
• The dashboard will show a red 🎙 XLR Feed badge on that session row
• IBM-provided ZOOM recorder must be connected via XLR for audio capture
Fields per session:
url        — Box shared link (empty = not yet available)
redownload — true = AV team needs to re-download this file
xlr_feed   — true = XLR audio feed required (connect ZOOM recorder)
label      — display name (do not change)
day        — used for grouping (do not change)
